protocol.live_candidates: QUARANTINE_UNASSIGNED; do not train or evaluate until provenance/review frozen
protocol.default_scope: FULL_FRAME; ROI-only reviews must be explicitly recorded and excluded from full-frame metrics

evaluation.assignment: scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment, one-to-one with explicit unmatched objects
evaluation.short_track_metrics: Only on human-matched 8-frame sequences; physical identity not inferred from direction

inference_budget.finetune: NOT_RUN until expert training labels and fixed validation split exist
inference_budget.static_scope: 12 source frames x FULL_FRAME and ROI, both routes; one warmup per scope plus explicit startup measurements
inference_budget.live_comparison_limit: Sequential camera trials are not identical input; fixed saved-video comparison is paired.

protocol.live_roi_basis: Original bridge_smoke first_frame, before A/B inference. No resize; same live ROI for both routes.
protocol.scene_coverage: Existing video and current live scene; scene/focus/turn/aggregate classes need expert confirmation.

coverage_semantics: Only explicitly reviewed pixels; no new approvals inferred
